ns2:course.label: Ling and the School Curr
ns2:course.description: Analyzes linguistics for the school curriculum including dialect diversities, use of language in social contexts, and variations in oral and written forms of language. Gives attention to classroom discourse in US and international settings, and ethnography of communication. Prerequisite: Admission to a doctoral program.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: Admission to a doctoral program.
